image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Triceratops head and upper torso emerging from behind wooden planks and green foliage. The dinosaur has textured, pebbled skin, a prominent beak, two long brow horns, and a shorter nasal horn. A large bony frill is visible behind the head. The lighting is dappled, suggesting sunlight filtering through leaves.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Three prominent horns: two long brow horns projecting forward and upward above the eyes, and a shorter nasal horn on the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays two large brow horns and a smaller nasal horn in the correct anatomical positions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beak is parrot-like with a sharp, keratinous cutting edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth features a distinct, curved, parrot-like beak structure typical of ceratopsians.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is quadrupedal with columnar, elephant-like limbs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a close-up of the head and shoulders; the limbs and full body posture are occluded or out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Enormous bony frill (neck shield) extending posteriorly from the skull, with width dramatically exceeding the skull itself.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frill is clearly visible behind the head, appearing solid and wide, consistent with Triceratops morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Frill is solid bone with a smooth outer surface and possible epoccipital (marginal) bumps.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the frill appears solid and textured, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is inferred to have been covered in large, hexagonal scales with possible quill-like structures along the back and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture is highly detailed, showing small, pebbled/hexagonal scales across the face and frill.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forelimbs are shorter than hindlimbs creating a sloping backline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are not visible in this cropped composition.
The tail is completely out of frame.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The right eye appears slightly glassy and lacks the complex biological depth of a real animal eye, resembling a plastic model or statue. The transition between the eyelid and the eyeball is slightly soft.
The lower beak seems to merge slightly into the upper beak without a clear, sharp hinge line, though this could be due to the angle. It looks slightly fused.
The wooden planks in the background have slightly inconsistent perspective lines, appearing to warp gently rather than following strict linear perspective.
